doc.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier and Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-01-18

title: Breaking Sensation and Climax Rag
summary: Cie asks how to break rags like Joplin's Sensation and Climax Rag. Williams answers mostly in demonstration, and says he played it with George Lewis.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Say, when you'll be playing a reg, say like, you know, Joplin's Sensation? Sensation? Sensation? I don't know. You remember the climax rag, George Lewis? Lyrite Theatre, you know the climax? How would you break them? How would you break them? Sensation. Sensation. You haven't played that here for many years, honey. Which one? Well, what's a rag builder rocking? Sensation. I don't know. You remember Climax rag, George Lewis.
Oh, Climax. How would you break that, say? Well, that's in the sea. That's like the mid-mammogacy. You just break...
I played it with George and myself. I believe in a few minutes after that I was... Yeah! ...
